Result likelihood estimates how often an earlier game was at least this far above or below expectation, on that side only. Lower percentages mean more unusual results. Uses only earlier dates, pools both team perspectives, and needs 1,000 prior games; it is not an exact-score or win probability.

About team colors

School colors can be shared. A highlighted line retains its team color while other series are dimmed. Colors are display metadata and never affect rankings.

How to read this report

Expected margin = (this team’s marbles − opponent’s marbles) ÷ 10, plus 3 points at home, minus 3 away, or zero at a neutral site. Each point above expectation earns one marble from the opponent; each point below transfers one marble to the opponent. Balances can go negative. Every season starts at zero.

Only included Division I games affect these rankings. Game counts and records may differ from a team’s official overall schedule. Final scoring includes overtime. Some historical dates use opening-day ratings for every prediction, with transfers applied together; those closing balances are labeled in the ledger.

Source: SportsDataverse’s ESPN-derived results and historical D-I membership. This report reflects the saved data snapshot, including its coverage limits. Pace adjustment and season carryover are not active. Team logos show current provider branding; historical designs may differ.

Every transfer has two sides. The season’s signed marble balances sum to zero.
